crossRefs.note: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds,
Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she…
Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
crossRefs.keyword: mine enemies. Heb. those that observe me

crossRefs.note: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
crossRefs.keyword: mine enemies. Heb. those that observe me

crossRefs.note: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.

translations.web: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
translations.bsb: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
translations.kjv: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
translations.asv: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.
